scope: Independent re-review of current local software and submitted source archive; no application changes or hardware actuation.
rubric: Reviewer-defined, not an official CPRI rubric. Score concerns a 24-hour software prototype, not utility deployment.
organizer_requirement: The original DT Problem Statement.pdf permits simulated datasets and expects later extension to sensors/utility monitoring. Physical hardware is not a prerequisite in that document.

findings.title: Thermal-deviation detection does not invalidate the nominal-cooling forecast
findings.implication: An alarm exists, but the apparent action window can be too optimistic. This is a synthetic counterexample, not a hardware observation.

findings.title: Two different inference paths have different information
findings.detail: Industrial operation/projection uses declared cooling and disturbance settings. The independent observation-only pipeline excludes them. Its benchmark is not evidence that the primary scenario-aware operator forecast independently diagnosed the fault.

findings.title: Observation-only pipeline requires a reported hotspot input
findings.reproduction: Removing hotspot_c from otherwise complete generated oil/ambient/load/voltage rows returns missing_data and withholds forecast.
findings.detail: Hotspot is not a listed required input in the organizer statement. Other oil-reference and prototype paths exist, but this advanced pipeline lacks an oil-only operating mode.

findings.title: Perfect condition number with a cooling warning
findings.detail: The warning is correctly retained; the number still visually suggests perfect condition. This was also visible in the current UI.

findings.title: Headline forecast score combines unlike conditions
findings.detail: Fixed origins 75/90/105/120/135/150 straddle disturbances injected at minute 100. Some large errors follow future input changes unavailable at forecast time. Future biased sensor readings are also used as targets. Report unchanged-input error, changed-input stress performance and latent-plant physical error separately.
findings.group_note: Diagnostic groups are not mutually exclusive: healthy rows occur in post-onset clock positions, without a fault. These are not new benchmark claims.

findings.title: Cooling-detection gain is mainly persistent-deviation detection
findings.detail: The five additional detections take 15/35/40/40/80 minutes and none crosses critical in this evaluation. All three cooling misses are mild and noncritical within the evaluation. Do not equate event recall with proven imminent-failure warning.

findings.title: Narrow validation coverage
findings.detail: 24 parameter/noise seeds crossed with ten conditions in one synthetic plant family, fixed event onset and assumed healthy prefix. CUSUM requires one-minute cadence; a two-minute resampling disables it. No calibrated uncertainty interval or independently validated 240-minute planning performance.

findings.title: CPRI phase data is represented as acceptance examples, not a phase-resolved twin
findings.detail: Supplied workbook includes IR/IY/IB and VR/VY/VB. Current main industrial model assumes balanced three-phase RMS and unity power factor; core telemetry has no per-phase model.

findings.title: Prototype engineering is proven more strongly than production operation
findings.detail: Tests and restart rehearsal are meaningful. Full-run JSON persistence, browser-driven simulation stepping and repeated retrieval of records are prototype architecture; no measured fleet-scale latency, soak, backup-restore or field-validation result was established by this review.

findings.title: Demonstration needs a narrower story
findings.detail: Separate industrial, physical, reference and emulator workflows have honest provenance but create navigation and trust-level complexity. The next-step panel is verbose; validation tables require interpretation; strong method details risk obscuring the operator decision.

recommended_order: Withhold action-time claims after an unexplained thermal residual, or qualify an updated model before use.
Make observation-based forecasting/diagnosis the central demonstration and expose scenario truth only in a separate comparison.
Add an oil-only observation mode and define temperature-channel provenance.
Partition evaluation by held assumptions and physical versus sensor targets; report lead-time/error trade-offs.
Reconcile the condition index with active defects and improve the one-case demo.
